concerns.text: FR-001 requires ingesting data 'from NIST and Journal of Materials Science sources', but the plan's Phase 0 explicitly states no verified open download exists for those sources and substitutes a real-file gate at data/raw/diffusion_measurements.csv. No plan element can satisfy FR-001's named-source ingestion as written; the spec must be amended (the plan's own Scope Correction Request agrees). Until the spec names an obtainable source, FR-001 is unbacked.

FR-009 mandates an a-priori power analysis 'confirming that a sample size of >= 200 satisfies' power >= 0.80 and CI widths <= 0.1. The plan implements only a post-hoc power analysis and treats the a-priori thresholds as targets to check. The a-priori confirmation required by FR-009 has no backing plan element; the spec needs amendment or the plan needs an explicit a-priori design step (e.g., simulation-based power using the schema, clearly labeled as design-time, not results).

FR-005 requires 'refitting the full model pipeline on each resample'; Phase 5 refits at 'fixed best hyperparameters for feasibility, documented'. This is a reasonable, documented deviation, but it weakens FR-005's literal text — either amend FR-005 to permit fixed hyperparameters or add a plan note justifying why hyperparameter re-search per resample is infeasible within FR-006's 6 h budget, so the deviation is spec-sanctioned rather than silent.
